sources.scope: Selected Flora of China diagnosis through web retrieval: green jointed axes, reduced opposite connate scale leaves and red fleshy paired seed bracts. Source questions eastern versus European conspecificity; no model resolution of that complex is claimed.

retrieval.accessMethod: Selected institutional botanical description through web retrieval; direct local HTML unavailable

findings.shape: A selected low branching female shrub has connected green internodes, explicit joints, opposite reduced scale-leaf pairs and selected red fleshy paired seed-bract cues with dark exposed seed regions. The stems supply the conspicuous green form.
findings.surface: Original numerical connected woody/green axes, individual curved leaf surfaces, subdued pigment variation and selected reproductive surfaces. No source photograph pixels or measured tissue optical parameters.
findings.movement: Same retained woody axes, rachises, leaves and reproductive surfaces during small authored external deflection. Root/support position and scale remain anchored. Timing and angles are qualitative; there is no wind/elasticity solver, physiological simulation or measured biomechanics. Complete germination, organ emergence and seed-to-adult development are unavailable; no resizing of a ready mature plant.
findings.evidenceScope: Selected Flora of China diagnosis through web retrieval: green jointed axes, reduced opposite connate scale leaves and red fleshy paired seed bracts. Source questions eastern versus European conspecificity; no model resolution of that complex is claimed.
corrections: Replaced the upright brush-like draft with clustered low procumbent green internodes, explicit joints and reduced opposite scale-leaf cues.
Added attached paired fleshy red seed-bract structures with dark seed cues and varied branch origins.
Increased selected stem branching and closed small distal stem tips; retained the same stems and bracts during small external deflection.
findings.residual: Stem architecture remains sparse and radially regular compared with the dense authentic shrub. Bracts are smooth and stylized; exact bract fusion, seed exposure, internode dimensions and epidermal detail are unmeasured. Very close support focus clips a foreground stem at the camera near plane. Regional conspecificity is explicitly questioned in the consulted Flora of China; the match does not resolve that taxonomic issue. No seedling development or mechanical/physiological validation.
